preconditions.description: The size of the arrays is at least 1 and at most 2 * 10^5.
Each element in array a is at least 1 and at most 10^9.
Each element in array b is at least 1 and at most 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimum possible value of the sum of absolute differences.

invariants.description: The length of array a is equal to n.
The length of array b is equal to n.
